gizmo.title: Umboniso wemeko
gizmo.description: Umboniso omnye wemeko enamasebe. Nxibelelanisa ukhetho ngalunye nomnye umboniso nge-# ilandelwa yi-id yomboniso wayo.

configure.title: I-id yomboniso
configure.description: Oko ukhetho lunxibelelana nako: ikhonkco eliya ku-# lilandelwa yile id likhokelela kulo mboniso. Oonobumba, amanani nezihlanganisi.

configure.title: Isiphelo
configure.description: Ingaba lo mboniso uphelisa indlela, nokuba kuphume njani.

configure.title: Amanqaku
configure.description: Amanqaku okufikelela kwesi siphelo. Amanqaku aphezulu esiphelo kwimeko ngawona aphezulu.
